title: Call Transcript
description:
v2 (post-M16) — captures a recorded conversation (discovery call, pitch call, catch-up, negotiation, follow-up) involving one or more brand_contacts. Linked optionally to a deal (active pipeline), an enrollment (the outreach that produced the call), and one or more talents the agency was representing. The transcript itself is a large artefact stored in S3/MinIO; this schema records the metadata + structured summary + provenance. LLM-driven summary + action-item extraction happens on upload (Claude Haiku) and lands inline so the CRM person profile can render it without re-reading the raw file.

Why a standalone schema (not folded into brand_contact): transcripts can be 50-500KB raw, JSONB rows become unwieldy; multiple back-references (contact, deal, enrollment, talent) make a separate table cleaner; access control + retention policy is per-transcript not per-contact.

agency_id.description: Multi-tenant scope. Required in v2 SaaS. All cross-record queries MUST filter by agency_id.

kind.description: Conversation type. Drives default UI labels + filters.

occurred_at.description: When the call actually happened (NOT the upload time).

attendees.description: Everyone on the call. Mix of agency-side + brand-side + talent-side participants. Each entry tries to resolve to a known entity (agent_id / contact_id / talent_id) but accepts a free-text fallback for guest attendees the agent recognises but isn't in the system yet.

email.description: Captured from calendar invite; encrypted at rest.

linked_contact_ids.description: Required. brand_contact ids this transcript is filed under. Usually 1 (the brand-side participant) but a multi-stakeholder call can list several. Each contact's call_transcript_ids[] gets this transcript_id appended.

linked_deal_id.description: Optional FK to the active pipeline deal this call relates to (e.g. a negotiation transcript on a deal in substage=`negotiation`). If set, the transcript surfaces on the deal's M10 history view.

linked_brand_deal_id.description: Optional FK to a historical brand_deal row. Used when the call relates to a previously-closed deal (renewal_check_in / performance_review / catch_up on a past relationship).

linked_enrollment_id.description: Optional FK to the pitch_enrollment that produced this call (e.g. an `interested` reply led to a discovery_call → the transcript references the enrollment that triggered it).

linked_talent_ids.description: Talents the agency was representing on this call. A pitch_call about Jane Doe lists ["jane-fitstar"]; a multi-talent brief might list several.

source.description: Where the transcript came from. v2 ships manual_upload (agent drops a .txt / .md / .vtt / .docx) + Otter / Fireflies / Grain via API integration. Vendor selection per `docs/vendor_roadmap.md` — Phase 4.6 § call transcript links.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag. Auto-detected on upload; agent can override.

recording_consent_obtained.description: Compliance flag — did all call participants explicitly consent to recording? Required for some regions (EU two-party-consent jurisdictions, California). UI surfaces this prominently on upload; defaults False. Transcripts without consent are flagged + access-restricted to the uploading agent.

raw_file.description: Reference to the actual transcript file in object storage. Never inlined.

summary_markdown.description: LLM-generated structured summary (Claude Haiku) — sections: tl;dr / key_takeaways / objections_raised / next_steps_agreed. Regenerable via POST /api/v1/call-transcripts/{id}/resummarize. Agent can edit inline; edits are preserved across regenerations.

speaker.description: Display name of speaker, or contact_id reference.

key_quotes.description: Quotable moments for the agent to reference in follow-ups or the next pack. LLM-extracted on upload.

action_items.description: Structured to-dos extracted by the LLM. Open items roll up into the agent's daily/weekly digest. Closing an action_item is a PATCH operation; status changes are audit-logged.

sentiment_overall.description: Aggregate read of the conversation tone (LLM-classified).

topics_discussed.description: Free-form short tags pulled by the LLM — e.g. ["pricing", "exclusivity", "q3-launch", "renewal"].

memo_ids_created.description: Memos auto-created from this transcript (action_items that map onto strategic insights become memo rows tagged with the right brand_ids / talent_ids / topics). Read back by future M11+ packs.

is_sensitive.description: Agent can mark transcripts containing confidential business info (e.g. brand's internal budget figures) as sensitive. Sensitive transcripts: (a) excluded from default cross-talent prep-pack context, (b) require explicit per-request access, (c) audit-logged on every read.

keep_until.description: Auto-delete on this date. Default: 7 years from occurred_at.

legal_hold.description: When true, blocks auto-deletion regardless of keep_until.

agent_notes.description: Free-text agent annotations on top of the LLM summary. Survives summary regeneration.
